<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4H1Mzs/wbwriter/main/Assets/logo-mark-1024.png" width="72" align="right" alt="WBWriter">

### What's new

- **Remote recovery** in web control:
  - **Refresh display** rebuilds the touchscreen and HDMI windows when a display shows the board wrongly. The writing, the message and NDI® keep running, so the LED wall doesn't blink.
  - **Restart WBWriter** (tap twice) restarts the app. It comes back live with the same board and the same message.
- **Uptime** on the web control page: how long WBWriter has been running and how long it has been live, next to the current NDI status and network load.
- A link to [ndi.video](https://ndi.video/) next to the NDI settings, as the NDI license asks.

### Download

WBWriter 1.1.1 or later offers this update by itself at launch. Otherwise download **`WBWriter-1.5.0.dmg`** (macOS 13+, Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized), open it and drag WBWriter into Applications.

Linux and Windows are coming soon.
